messages.content: Review a concrete experimental decision, not an attack implementation. In a released pretrained DINO-WM MetaWorld Reach reproduction, native CEM scores visual-feature MSE + 0.1 proprio MSE to a fixed expert goal. World forecasts receive unbounded normalized actions; executor affine-denormalizes then clips only XYZ to [-1,1]. We tested exact physical execution-equivalent copied forecast requests, keeping original candidates/executor/goal/scoring fixed. Single exploratory 5-candidate bank: original selects c2 with actual replay U30=7.6994, fixed saturation amplitude +2 also c2 and same full ranking, proposed boundary canonicalization selects c1 with U30=1.8297. Mean latent forecast error against actual future encodings decreases .9291 -> .6886 -> .4272. True-future encodings scored by the same native objective also select c1. Thus local forecast-mediated utility loss and objective/reward mismatch coexist; the planned +2 manipulation failed and canonicalization cannot be relabeled its successful attack. Existing native full CEM Clean succeeded2/3 versus noop0/3, but servo ever-success3/3 and higher cumulative return all3, so no blanket forecast necessity claim. No independent or full native canonicalization result yet. Native settings 300 candidates,15 iterations,H6,execute15controls/replan,99controls+warmup. One pair costs historically6-11min GPU; shared GPU may lengthen it. New concrete hypothesis: a declared constrained preprocessing writer can alter only execution-equivalent copied prediction requests and degrade native closed-loop utility despite prediction improvement. Consider a new, fixed, previously unused root seed4, original vs canonical full native CEM matched RNG/budget, no seed/magnitude search. Is a bounded single paired pilot justified, or is the mechanism too generic/poorly motivated for our high novelty security objective? State strongest defensible one-sentence claim if future evidence supports it, decisive confound controls (do not require oracle-optimal Clean), genuinely nontrivial defense direction without big-model training, and stop conditions. Distinguish feasibility pilot from paper-level novelty. Do not invent prior work or results. Return concise Chinese JSON with fields decision, rationale, claim, minimal_controls, defense_limit, stop_conditions.

message.content:
{
  "decision": "允许进行单次严格受限的成对 Pilot 实验（Seed 4，Original 对比 Canonical，完全匹配算力与 RNG 预算），但必须将其严格定性为“机制可行性探针”，而非论文级安全创新主干；若未通过预设判定，立即终止该方向。",
  "rationale": "当前探索仅存在单步 5-candidate 局部观测，且预测精度提升（误差降至 .4272）反而导致实用性下降的现象，与“真实未来特征在原生目标下同样偏好 c1”高度重合，说明强烈的原生目标/奖励失配（Objective Mismatch）深度介入，不能简单归因于安全性攻击。单对 Pilot 计算成本较低（历史约 6-11 分钟），适合用于闭环证伪；但若将通用的输入规范化暴露出的原生规划脆弱性包装为新型攻击，安全动机薄弱且创新性不足，故仅限低成本机制验证，严禁参数与种子搜索。",
  "claim": "在基于视觉世界模型的无界动作输入规划闭环中，对执行等价的预测请求施加确定性边界规范化，可在显著降低潜在表征预测误差的同时，因预测流形与原生评价目标的未对齐而引发严重的闭环控制效用退化。",
  "minimal_controls": [
    "执行等价性绝对校验：验证经规范化改写的预测动作序列在经过完全相同的仿射反归一化和执行端裁剪后，下发到底层环境的物理控制指令与原始动作完全恒等。",
    "真实未来特征评估对齐组（Ground-truth Encoding Control）：在规划节点同步提取候选动作实际执行后的真实未来状态编码，代入原生评分目标计算排名，用于解耦效用退化究竟源于世界模型预测流形偏移还是原生评价目标自身的奖励失配（Reward Mismatch）。",
    "开环伺服参照基准（Servo Baseline）：保留无预测介入的直连伺服控制作为效用锚点，排除因 CEM 规划器在 MetaWorld Reach 任务上本身次优造成的虚假效用波动。"
  ],
  "defense_limit": "在无需重训庞大世界模型的前提下，非平凡防御不能仅做简单的输入端裁剪或映射（这正是触发退化的机制），而应在规划评分阶段引入基于预测敏感度/雅可比范数的惩罚项，或在 CEM 内部构建测试时测试误差与执行边界一致性重投影滤波（Test-time Invariance Filter），强制规划器抑制处于模型训练流形边缘的伪最优候选。",
  "stop_conditions": [
    "在 Seed 4 全闭环运行中，Canonical 组的累积回报/成功率与 Original 组相比无显著退化（即全闭环 CEM 具备在线纠偏能力，局部退化未传导至全闭环）。",
    "真实未来特征评估与预测特征评估完全同向变化，证明效用降低 100% 由 DINO-WM 原生目标函数缺陷主导，与世界模型预测机制无关。",
    "共享 GPU 排队或实际耗时显著超过 30 分钟，破坏单次极低试错成本的原则。"
  ]
}
